items.body: اعترف سعود عبدالحميد، ظهير لانس الفرنسي والمنتخب السعودي، أنه خسر أكثر من نصف راتبه الذي كان يتقاضاه في دوري روشن، من أجل الاحتراف في الملاعب الأوروبية خلال السنوات الماضية. وانتقل سعود عبدالحميد من الهلال السعودي إلى روما الإيطالي خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية لعام 2024، لكنه فشل في الحصول على مقعد أساسي، ليقرر الانتقال إلى لانس الذي يلعب له منذ 2025. صعوبات الاحتراف وقال عبدالحميد، في تصريحات لبرنامج "في المرمى" عبر قنوات "العربية" السعودية: "من الطبيعي أن ينخفض راتبي عندما أنتقل إلى أوروبا، لأنهم لن يمنحوني نفس الراتب الذي كنت أتقاضاه في دوري روشن". وأضاف: "أعتقد أنني خسرت أكثر من 50% من راتبي، ولكن أنا مرتاح في الوضع الذي أنا فيه في الوقت الحالي". وعن سبب فشله في إثبات نفسه مع روما، قال: "عندما انتقلت لم تكن الظروف مناسبة، حيث لم أنجح في الحصول على فرصة، بالإضافة إلى أزمة اللغة، حيث لم أكن أعرف الإيطالية، ولم يكن هناك سوى 3 لاعبين يجيدون اللغة الإنجليزية، وهم من كانوا ينقلوا لي تعليمات المدرب". وأردف: "اللاعب السعودي لم يكن معروفًا عندهم، لذا لم تكن هناك ثقة كبيرة بالنسبة لي، لكن حدث تغير كبير بعد الانتقال إلى لانس، لأن نصفهم مسلمون وعرب ومغاربة، وهذا جعلني مرتاحًا بشكل أكبر، وأنا من طلبت الرحيل عن روما بسبب عدم الحصول على فرصة". تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشتر تذكرتك الآن…

items.summary: حسم الاتحاد الدولي لكرة القدم "فيفا" الجدل المثار حول حقيقة تحطيم محمد صلاح، قائد المنتخب المصري، رقم الأسطورة حسام حسن كأفضل هداف في تاريخ "الفراعنة"، بعد ثنائيته في شباك مالاوي.

items.title: رافينيا يهاجم الحكم بشراسة: ارتكب أخطاء غير مقبولة لصالح اليابان

items.body: شنّ رافينيا، نجم برشلونة ومنتخب البرازيل، هجوما حادا على حكم المباراة الودية التي خسر خلالها منتخب بلاده أمام اليابان بنتيجة 3-2، صباح اليوم السبت، معتبرا أن الأخطاء التحكيمية أثرت بشكل واضح على مجريات اللقاء. وشهدت المباراة، التي قادها المدرب كارلو أنشيلوتي، طرد رافينيا والمدير الفني للمنتخب البرازيلي، عقب اعتراضهما على قرارات الحكم بعد تسجيل اليابان هدفها الثالث. وقال رافينيا، في تصريحات لشبكة "جلوبو" عقب المباراة : "في البداية، أود أن أستغل الفرصة للاعتذار عن حالة الطرد، فمن الصعب السيطرة على النفس في مثل هذه المواقف، خاصة مع كثرة الأخطاء التي ارتكبها الحكم". وأضاف: "حاولت التحدث معه، لكنني لم أشعر بأنه منفتح على الحوار. أعتقد أنه ارتكب العديد من الأخطاء خلال المباراة، وسأحاول أن أصدق أنها كانت مجرد أخطاء، لكن ما حدث غير مقبول". وتابع نجم برشلونة: "كان هناك خطأ قبل الهدف الأول، كما أن اللاعب لمس الكرة بيده، لكن يمكن تفهم ذلك وفقا للقواعد الحالية. كذلك كانت هناك ركلة جزاء واضحة لصالحي، ثم جاء هدفهم الثالث". وأوضح: "كان هناك خطأ واضح للغاية ضد جواو، لكن الحكم قرر استمرار اللعب، وبمساعدة تقنية حكم الفيديو المساعد، احتسب الهدف". واستكمل رافينيا: "حاولنا تقديم أفضل ما لدينا منذ بداية المباراة، دون أن نتجاهل الأمور التي يتعين علينا تحسينها. نحن نتطور وبدأنا نجد أنفسنا داخل الملعب". و…

items.title: How I freed up 36GB on my Android phone without deleting a single photo
items.summary: No SD card, no problem.
items.body: Credit: Pankil Shah / Android Authority My Galaxy S26 only has 256GB of internal storage, and there’s no SD card slot to expand it. So yes, storage is a constant struggle for me, especially with a camera this good that I just can’t stop using. But I wasn’t about to sacrifice my precious photos to free up space, so I went looking for other ways to do it. I went through forgotten apps, bloated caches, offline downloads, and old files I didn’t need anymore. It helped free up 36GB of storage, and more importantly, it wasn’t anywhere near as tedious as I kept assuming it would be.

items.title: How to tell if a Black Friday deal is actually worth it
items.summary: After years of hunting Black Friday deals, here's the key to separating the bargains from the bluster.
items.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority I’ve spent the best part of a decade hunting down deals for Android Authority , and I learned very quickly that a big discount doesn’t necessarily mean you’re getting a bargain. Black Friday is a particularly good time to remember this, with retailers plastering huge percentage discounts over everything in sight. Contrary to the memes, some are genuinely excellent deals — I can assure you that some tech devices will hit their lowest price ever this month. But you’ll also see many ‘Black Friday deal’ labels on discounts at a price higher than three months ago. Thankfully, there’s a very easy way to tell the difference. The key to assessing a Black Friday deal is to use a price tracker. These tools let you see what a product has cost over recent months or even years, so you can judge for yourself whether that 50% discount is really worth getting excited about. They’re so easy to use that it’ll barely be slowing your shopping spree down at all once you’re in the rhythm. I’ll walk you through it here.

items.body: TL;DR Google’s November 2026 Pixel update still hasn’t fixed a Private Space bug that first surfaced in September. Switching between light and dark modes causes the hidden Private Space section to reappear in the app drawer, even when it’s set to remain hidden. Google has acknowledged a potentially related issue on its Issue Tracker, but there’s no confirmed fix yet. Google’s big November update packs dozens of bug fixes , but a recent Private Space issue, which unhides the hidden folder in the app drawer, appears to have again slipped through the cracks. For reference, the bug first surfaced following Android 17 QPR1 in September. Fast-forward to Android 17 QPR2 , and the bug is still there. For those unaware, Pixel’s Private Space lets you create a sandbox within your phone. It essentially acts as a separate, locked space where you can keep apps, folders, files, and anything that you want to keep away from prying eyes. The locked space appears at the bottom of the Pixel app drawer, though users also have the option to completely hide the space’s existence.

items.title: After BP monitoring smartwatches, HUAWEI reveals its first continuous glucose monitor
items.summary: Data from the CGM can also be viewed directly on a HUAWEI smartwatch.
items.body: Credit: Weibo / Huawei TL;DR HUAWEI has revealed a continuous glucose monitor in China. HUAWEI Sence G1 is the company’s first-ever Class III medical device. HUAWEI hasn’t shared details about availability but said it has been in development for over three years. HUAWEI may have been nearly wiped out of international markets by sanctions imposed on it during the first tenure of US President Donald Trump, but it remains at the top of China’s leaderboard. Along with its innovations across slab phones, foldables , and laptops —including laptops with foldable screens —HUAWEI also offers a broad range of wearables, including ones that monitor blood pressure . So far, the lineup has only comprised smartwatches and fitness bands, but HUAWEI is now adding a health-centric utility in the form of a glucose monitor. The HUAWEI Sence G1 is the company’s first continuous glucose monitor (CGM). The device works alongside other HUAWEI products, allowing users to view glucose levels on their phones, a smartwatch, or a HUAWEI fitness band. Besides monitoring a user’s glucose levels, the CGM will also alert them in case of any unusual spikes or dips.

items.title: 5 AI agents you can actually use on Android in 2026 (and who should use them)
items.summary: There are many options, but let's explore 5 popular options out there.
items.body: Credit: Megan Ellis / Android Authority The AI industry has evolved significantly over the last few years. While chatbots remain one of the most common entry points into the world of AI, agentic systems are also gaining momentum. Early on, most agents had pretty limited capabilities, but that’s slowly changing as agents emerge that not only assist you with minimal manual oversight, but also offer deeper control over apps, platforms, and even Android itself. Agentic AI could transform how we do many tasks, from planning and tracking finances to scheduling our lives and more. Right now, there are multiple different types of agentic AI systems out there. Let’s take a look at just five of the most interesting platforms out there, designed as semi-autonomous assistants useful to a wide range of folks, from everyday users to power users and professionals.

Users get to choose from a range of weather conditions and temperature options before submitting their report. This user feedback option comes amid a wave of online complaints about Pixel Weather. Google’s Pixel Weather could soon let users report inaccurate weather forecasts directly from the app. In the past, we’ve seen incidents where Pixel Weather’s data has been off the mark , and it now looks like Google is taking steps to fix that. APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship. items.title: Motorola Razr Plus 2024 starts receiving Android 17, but US owners still have to wait
items.summary: Months of beta testing are giving way to a stable release.
items.body: TL;DR Android 17 has started rolling out to the Motorola Razr Plus 2024, beginning with its European counterpart, the Razr 50 Ultra. US availability hasn’t been confirmed, and there’s still no verified rollout for the standard Razr 2024. The update has been spotted on a European Razr 50 Ultra, which is the same phone sold in the US as the Razr Plus 2024. While there’s no confirmed US rollout yet, a stable build on its international counterpart is an encouraging sign for American owners.

items.title: Motorola Signature 27 could have a downgraded 5,500mAh battery in some markets (Update)
items.summary: It looks like Motorola's flagship phone won't have a 7,000mAh battery everywhere.
items.body: Credit: Stephen Radochia / Android Authority TL;DR A regulatory filing has revealed that the Motorola Signature 27 is available in two models, with each having a different battery capacity. The standard phone has a rated capacity of 6,790mAh, while the downgraded model has a rated capacity of 5,350mAh. It’s not clear which countries will receive the Signature 27 with a smaller battery. Update: November 13, 2026 (6:26 AM ET): It looks like Motorola was indeed planning to offer a Signature 27 with a 5,500mAh battery in some markets. The phone’s product page mentioned a smaller battery in markets like Germany and the UK (see first screenshot below), but this has subsequently been updated to only mention a 7,000mAh battery. In fact, Google still mentions a 5,500mAh battery, as seen in the second image below. We’ve asked Motorola for clarity regarding this battery situation and will update our article accordingly. Here’s hoping the Signature 27 is available with a 7,000mAh battery in all markets.

items.body: Credit: Stephen Radochia / Android Authority On paper, the Motorola Signature 27 looks like an almost unbeatable flagship. With a massive 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, an eye-catching 200MP telephoto camera, and a newer 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, Motorola has built an uncompromising spec-sheet juggernaut. Yet, numbers in a vacuum do not make a flagship a must-buy. Here are six reasons you should pick Samsung’s flagship over Motorola’s latest challenger.

items.title: Pixel’s November update is breaking AOD, lock screen, and notifications for some users
items.summary: Bugs introduced with the November 2026 update continue to pile up for Pixel owners.
items.body: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Pixel users are reporting several sporadic issues after the November update. From Desktop Mode to AOD, Lock screen, and notification drawers, a lot of basic Pixel features don’t work as they should. A larger pool of users are witnessing accidental touches and unresponsive cameras. It’s not uncommon for new Pixel updates to introduce more problems than new features. We’ve been seeing a similar phenomenon for almost a year, and I’ve lamented about it to no avail. Google has admitted that nearly 75% of all internal code is written by AI, and that appears to be affecting yet another round of updates released this week. The recent November 2026 Pixel Drop that brought a host of AI features, especially to the Pixel 10 series, and supposedly dozens of bug fixes also appears to be causing a wide range of sporadic issues for Pixel owners. We’ve come across several reports on Reddit, suggesting users are struggling with unexplained issues since the update.

items.title: Google Sheets now lets others explore your data without accessing your spreadsheet
items.summary: Let your data do the talking, without revealing everything else.
items.body: TL;DR Google Sheets now lets users publish Gemini-powered Canvas dashboards, calendars, and task boards through shareable links. People can interact with a published Canvas without accessing or editing the original spreadsheet. Users can control who sees the Canvas and choose whether it updates automatically when spreadsheet data changes. Google Sheets is great for organizing information, but sharing it with others isn’t always convenient. Say you’re managing a project with multiple deadlines and tasks. You might have everything organized in a spreadsheet, but no one wants to scroll through dozens of rows just to see what’s happening next. Google already has a feature called Canvas that uses Gemini to turn spreadsheet data into interactive dashboards, calendars, and task boards. Now, it’s making these creations easier to share by giving them their own links, without requiring access to the original spreadsheet.

items.title: Google Fitbit Air syncing issues leave some iPhone users unable to access health data
items.summary: Google reportedly knows about the issue.
items.body: TL;DR Fitbit Air users, particularly those on iOS, are reporting persistent syncing and pairing issues with Google Health. Some users are encountering Error 16, while others are unable to reconnect their trackers after disconnecting them. Google support has reportedly acknowledged a known issue, but there’s no confirmed fix yet. A reset workaround has helped some users. The Google Fitbit Air seems to be giving iOS users a tough time, with several users coming forward and sharing complaints about syncing and pairing issues . These aren’t isolated reports — several users, across Reddit and Google’s official support forum, shared their experience with similar Fitbit Air connectivity problems, suggesting that the issue is affecting more than a small subset of users. Reports about the issue can be traced back to early October , with fresh complaints continuing into November. While the exact symptoms vary for different users, most of the complaints mainly revolve around the Fitbit Air being unable to sync data with iOS devices and persistent error messages.

items.title: WHOOP Humans turns your sleep, recovery, and workouts into an AI-free social feed
items.summary: WHOOP Humans wants to replace social media bots with a human-only network built on your health data.
items.body: Credit: Jimmy Westenberg / Android Authority TL;DR WHOOP has announced the launch of WHOOP Humans. The feature acts as a social network experience where users choose what health metrics to share with friends and family. Moments allows users to share photos from workouts, personal milestones, and more. With the proliferation of bots, automated accounts, AI, and manufactured content, it’s not hard to see why some people are getting tired of social media. However, WHOOP wants to bring the human aspect back to online interactions. To do so, the company is rolling out its own social networking experience in the WHOOP app. Starting today, members of the WHOOP app will have access to a new tab called Humans. According to the company, “WHOOP Humans offers a fundamentally different approach to connection: a network that is entirely human.” Unlike legacy social media platforms, this won’t be a place where you post text-based status updates to curate your online persona. Instead, you’ll be posting the WHOOP data you want to share with your followers, including Sleep, Recovery, Strain, activities, and achievements.

items.title: YouTube TV ‘Video unavailable’ screen is interrupting shows and sporting events
items.summary: YouTube TV viewers report that their shows are getting disrupted by a black screen.
items.body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR Users are experiencing an issue with YouTube TV. Reports claim that the service is showing a black screen with the message “Video unavailable.” The issue may be specific to NBC. YouTube TV recently experienced a bug that caused channels to go missing in the Live tab . Fortunately, Google was quick to act and has rolled out a fix for the issue. Just as things were getting back to normal, it appears another bug has reared its ugly head. This time, the problem is causing users to miss crucial moments in their shows. Imagine watching a basketball game with the score tied up and only seconds left on the clock. As your team inbounds the ball and puts up a shot, a black screen with a message that reads “Video Unavailable” disrupts the action. The feature was manually enabled and is still in development, with no confirmed release date. Your Samsung Galaxy can already block unwanted calls , and the South Korean tech giant now appears to be preparing an easy way for you to keep track of just how many such calls your phone has filtered out. However, what Samsung seems to be working on is a more detailed dashboard.

items.body: Credit: Megan Ellis / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s hidden server-side target app list on Android 17 reveals 134 apps tied to Gemini task automation: 114 on stable Android 17 QPR2 and 20 extra test entries on Android Canary 2611. Apps must appear on this allowlist with matching Play Store signing certificates to run automated tasks, meaning regional Indian apps like Zomato and Blinkit work while unlisted rivals like Swiggy and Zepto are currently blocked. Being on the list does not guarantee immediate functionality, as productivity apps like Microsoft Word and Outlook are listed but don’t yet support direct in-app automation through Gemini. Gemini’s task automation is one of the more ambitious and impressive things Google has shipped on Android this year. Instead of handing you a link, Gemini opens the app on a virtual screen, taps through it on your behalf, and stops just before checkout so you can confirm. It began rolling out in March with just six apps: Lyft, Uber, Grubhub, DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Starbucks, on the Galaxy S26 series and later the Pixel 10 series . items.body: TL;DR Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of NVIDIA. The move follows two scandals: an affair with a foreign intelligence agent and one with a direct NVIDIA report. CFO Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO as the board searches for a replacement. In a move that has seemed inevitable for the past few days, Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of NVIDIA, according to a statement from the company . Moon, Venus and Spica Meet Explanation: Not all those who wander are lost. A night sky example is that planets wander, and in fact the very word “planet” comes from “wandering star” in Greek. As planets shift relative to fixed stars , they may appear from our perspective to get closer to other astronomical objects. Such meetings are called conjunctions . They don’t happen by chance, but follow the precise laws of celestial mechanics . This peaceful image , captured in Poland , shows the crescent Moon above the Tatra Mountains , and bright Venus close by, a little lower in the horizon. The bright star to the left of Venus is Spica in the constellation of Virgo , the Maiden. Spica is one of the brightest stars in the sky, only about 250 light-years away.
